cards.back:
A colourful underwater structure made by tiny animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: terumbu karang
Example: Many fish hide in the coral reef.
cards.say: coral reef. A colourful underwater structure made by tiny animals. Many fish hide in the coral reef.

cards.back:
Water that moves in one direction in a river or sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: arus
Example: A strong current pushed the boat to the shore.
cards.say: current. Water that moves in one direction in a river or sea. A strong current pushed the boat to the shore.

cards.back:
The regular rise and fall of the sea level.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasang surut
Example: The tide was low, so we walked on the sand.
cards.say: tide. The regular rise and fall of the sea level. The tide was low, so we walked on the sand.

cards.back:
The land at the edge of the sea or a lake.
Bahasa Indonesia: tepi laut
Example: We walked along the shore and found shells.
cards.say: shore. The land at the edge of the sea or a lake. We walked along the shore and found shells.

cards.back:
The floor of the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: dasar laut
Example: A sunken ship lay on the seabed.
cards.say: seabed. The floor of the sea. A sunken ship lay on the seabed.

cards.back:
A very large sea mammal that breathes air.
Bahasa Indonesia: paus
Example: The blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth.
cards.say: whale. A very large sea mammal that breathes air. The blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth.

cards.back:
A large fish with sharp teeth.
Bahasa Indonesia: hiu
Example: The shark swam slowly near the boat.
cards.say: shark. A large fish with sharp teeth. The shark swam slowly near the boat.

cards.back:
A sea animal with eight arms.
Bahasa Indonesia: gurita
Example: The octopus hid under a rock.
cards.say: octopus. A sea animal with eight arms. The octopus hid under a rock.

cards.back:
A soft sea animal that can sting.
Bahasa Indonesia: ubur-ubur
Example: A jellyfish floated near the beach.
cards.say: jellyfish. A soft sea animal that can sting. A jellyfish floated near the beach.

cards.back:
A plant-like living thing that grows in the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: rumput laut
Example: Seaweed was washed up on the sand.
cards.say: seaweed. A plant-like living thing that grows in the sea. Seaweed was washed up on the sand.

cards.back:
Tiny living things that float in the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: plankton
Example: Some whales eat plankton, which is very tiny.
cards.say: plankton. Tiny living things that float in the sea. Some whales eat plankton, which is very tiny.

cards.back:
To jump into water head first or swim deep underwater.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyelam
Example: Divers dive to see fish on the reef.
cards.say: dive. To jump into water head first or swim deep underwater. Divers dive to see fish on the reef.

cards.back:
A tower with a bright light to guide ships.
Bahasa Indonesia: mercusuar
Example: The lighthouse warns ships to stay away from rocks.
cards.say: lighthouse. A tower with a bright light to guide ships. The lighthouse warns ships to stay away from rocks.

cards.back:
A heavy metal tool that stops a boat from moving.
Bahasa Indonesia: jangkar
Example: The sailors dropped the anchor into the sea.
cards.say: anchor. A heavy metal tool that stops a boat from moving. The sailors dropped the anchor into the sea.

cards.back:
A person who works on a boat or ship.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelaut
Example: The sailor tied the rope to the mast.
cards.say: sailor. A person who works on a boat or ship. The sailor tied the rope to the mast.

cards.back:
A giant sea wave, often caused by an earthquake under the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: tsunami
Example: A tsunami warning told people to move to high ground.
cards.say: tsunami. A giant sea wave, often caused by an earthquake under the sea. A tsunami warning told people to move to high ground.

cards.back:
How deep something is.
Bahasa Indonesia: kedalaman
Example: The depth of the sea here is fifty metres.
cards.say: depth. How deep something is. The depth of the sea here is fifty metres.

cards.back:
Water from the sea that has salt in it.
Bahasa Indonesia: air asin
Example: Fish in the sea live in salt water.
cards.say: salt water. Water from the sea that has salt in it. Fish in the sea live in salt water.

cards.back:
A sea animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or clam.
Bahasa Indonesia: hewan laut bercangkang
Example: Shellfish live on rocks near the shore.
cards.say: shellfish. A sea animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or clam. Shellfish live on rocks near the shore.

cards.back:
A reptile with a hard shell that swims in the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: penyu
Example: The turtle laid its eggs on the beach.
cards.say: turtle. A reptile with a hard shell that swims in the sea. The turtle laid its eggs on the beach.

cards.back:
A sea animal with a hard shell and two claws.
Bahasa Indonesia: kepiting
Example: A crab walked sideways across the sand.
cards.say: crab. A sea animal with a hard shell and two claws. A crab walked sideways across the sand.

cards.back:
A ship that can travel under the water.
Bahasa Indonesia: kapal selam
Example: The submarine dived deep below the waves.
cards.say: submarine. A ship that can travel under the water. The submarine dived deep below the waves.

cards.back:
The average height of the sea's surface.
Bahasa Indonesia: permukaan laut
Example: The village is just above sea level.
cards.say: sea level. The average height of the sea's surface. The village is just above sea level.

cards.back:
A ship that has been badly damaged and sunk.
Bahasa Indonesia: bangkai kapal
Example: Divers found an old wreck on the seabed.
cards.say: wreck. A ship that has been badly damaged and sunk. Divers found an old wreck on the seabed.
